work_units.goal: T01 — a recurring fingerprint reopens its closed issue
T02 — the finding-meta marker records first seen and seen message ids, and never raises
T03 — closing a `dlq` finding acknowledges it until a new message arrives
T04 — a schedule is not "silent" before heartbeats began on its component
T05 — a finding has a readable title, labels, and an `error-logs` body a diagnosis can start from
T06 — an `http-5xx` finding names the exception and the dependency behind it
T07 — a `dlq` finding carries the dead-lettered message's details and recorded exception
T08 — a silent schedule says whether the job ran and the host was up; a stalled queue says how stale
